exception.label: IRN refused
exception.title: INV/26-27/0017 (Marina Car Care) has no IRN
exception.detail: The IRP refused it: The invoice is 103 days old. Above ₹10 crore turnover the portal refuses anything past 30 days, so this one can no longer be made valid — raise a credit note and re-invoice.. A B2B invoice without an IRN is not a valid tax invoice.

events.note: Found by the scheduler and given to its owner, to deal with by 2026-10-30.
Past its date: the owner was reminded.
3 days past its date: sent to the admins.
